test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following has NOT represented India in its Men's Cricket Test team as a wicketkeeper?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hanuma Vihari.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Hanuma Vihari :

 
 
• He is an Indian international cricketer.
 
• He represents Andhra Pradesh in Indian domestic cricket.
 
• A right-handed batsman and occasional right-arm off-break bowler.
 
• He was a member of the India Under-19 cricket team that won the 2012 ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup in Australia. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Wriddhiman Saha represents India as a wicket-keeper batsman.

 
 
• Wriddhiman Prasanta Saha is an Indian international cricketer who plays for the Indian national cricket team and first-class matches domestically for Bengal.
 
 
 
• Mahendra Singh Dhoni
 
 
• Mahendra Singh Dhoni is a former Indian international cricketer who captained the Indian national team in limited-overs formats from 2007 to 2017 and in Test cricket from 2008 to 2014.
 
• Under his captaincy, India won the inaugural 2007 ICC World Twenty20, the 2010 and 2016 Asia Cups, the 2011 ICC Cricket World Cup and the 2013 ICC Champions Trophy.
 
• He is widely regarded as one of the greatest wicket-keeper batsmen and captains in the history of the game.
 
• He was also the first wicket-keeper to effect 100 stumpings in ODI cricket.
 
• MS Dhoni announced his retirement from international cricket in August 2020.
 
 
 
• **Rishabh Pant** is the left-handed **wicket-keeper batsman **of the Indian cricket team.
 
 
• He is the present captain of the Delhi Capitals.
